limitSize.title: limitSize
limitSize.description: Maximum number of claims to return. If not provided, the default value of 10 will be used. The maximum allowed value is 50.

statusFilter.title: statusFilter
statusFilter.description:
Filter claims by status. Supported values are:
- pending (includes Draft and Under Review)
- approved
- rejected

If not provided, default to pending.

timeFilter.title: timeFilter
timeFilter.description:
Specify the time range for claims. Supported values are:
- today
- yesterday
- thisMonth
- lastMonth

This field is required to determine which claims to retrieve.
